population: All complete documents in the frozen GUM test file except the eight already examined in the bounded systems evaluation; exclusion is at document level
observation: Only raw text comments in original sentence order; join with a space and normalize using parse_text, so source sentence boundaries without punctuation are not supplied to raw mode. No UPOS, deprel, morphological case, type or gold phonemes enter inference.
fixed_model: GNN-built Brown/CMUdict/EWT train-only kernels and live pymdp Agents, optional numerically validated JIT acceleration with no change to parameters/schedule
primary_comparison: paired per-document predictive normalized-letter mean log loss: all-seven-channels-disabled minus integrated
uncertainty: document bootstrap percentile95 percent,10000 resamples, seed20261005; one primary comparison
secondary_descriptive: token and OOV coverage, per-level events, raw normalization coverage; any OOV means closed-vocabulary word log loss infinity, never omit OOVs from word denominator
frozen_constraints: No model, hyperparameter or protocol retuning from this evaluation. Runtime failures stop and are reported; no silently skipped documents. Already-examined eight documents are never added to this untouched population.
scope: Prospectively specified new population analysis under this engineering-fixed model; not external replication and not a claim of exact global inference. Final report must state sample size, input/source hashes and all excluded documents.
